linked_process_id.description: Identifier of the linked upstream or parent process (do not modify).

analysis_status.description: Status of the AKTA chromatography analysis.

analysis_timestamp.description: Timestamp when the analysis summary was generated.

summary.description: Summary metrics from AKTA chromatogram analysis.

n_peaks.description: Number of UV peaks detected in the chromatogram.

first_peak_time_min.description: Retention time of the first detected peak (minutes).

last_peak_time_min.description: Retention time of the last detected peak (minutes).

max_peak_height.description: Maximum UV peak height detected (as reported by analysis).

peaks.description: List of detected peaks with retention time and height.

index.description: Index of the peak in the time series.

time_min.description: Peak retention time in minutes (as used for plotting).

height.description: Peak height in UV signal units.

data_files.description: Output data file names from the analysis.

analysis_results_json.description: Path to analysis_results_<elab_id>.json produced by akta_analysis.py.

processed_data_csv.description: Path to akta_processed_data_<elab_id>.csv containing processed chromatogram data.

plots.description: Plot files generated by the analysis.

raw_analysis.description: Raw analysis JSON payload loaded from analysis_results_<elab_id>.json.
